gt_pass_rate_scope: THIS RUN'S SLICE ONLY (10 task(s)) — the fraction of the evaluated tasks whose own ground truth ran here. The whole-subset executor ceiling is executor.gt_pass_rate_ceiling, a different denominator.

untagged_reasoning.method: structural: text before the first ``` fence in raw_solution (the model's own output, post-proxy-strip). Detection only — no completion is ever modified. n_marker_hits is an advisory keyword cross-check, not the measure.
untagged_reasoning.correlation_with_non_pass: no correlation to assess: 0 of 10 completions carry untagged reasoning prose, so none of the non-passing tasks can be a stripping artifact. pass@1 reflects model capability under this executor.

executor.rlimits: disabled: macOS setrlimit(RLIMIT_AS/RLIMIT_DATA) returns EINVAL at any value, so BigCodeBench's default 30 GB caps make every task fail in reliability_guard before its test runs
executor.gt_pass_rate_ceiling_scope: ALL 148 BigCodeBench-hard tasks (134/148 ground truths pass, 14 fail), measured by env_health.py at bigcodebench ground-truth timing cache /Users/denisdresvyanskiy/Library/Caches/bigcodebench/f8d6f9609f8f9c528e1af2baf74ddb68.pkl. NOT this run's --limit slice: the slice number is the top-level `gt_pass_rate`.

proxy_stats.finish_reason_coverage: empty-after-strip choices only; BCB's own artifacts preserve no finish_reason at all

generation.completions_provenance: this-run — all 10 scored completions were generated through eval_proxy (10 requests logged, neutral sampling injected on each)

reasoning_stripped.verdict: enabled and observed on the TAGGED shapes: 10 of 10 responses had a tagged reasoning wrapper removed before scoring. Says nothing about the untagged shape in shape_not_covered, which is not detected
reasoning_stripped.shape_not_covered: untagged reasoning prose (a response that reasons in plain text with no delimiter at all, e.g. opening 'Thinking Process:'). eval_proxy's stripper is tag-anchored and passes this shape through unchanged. NOT fixed here by design: a keyword heuristic would corrupt legitimate prose in docstrings and comments. See eval/external/ifeval/README.md.
reasoning_stripped.untagged_leak_exposure_check: n_unparseable_solutions + n_no_program (top level) are the heuristic-free exposure check: untagged reasoning that survived into a scored answer cannot be parsed as Python. Both 0 means no untagged leak reached scoring in this run.

comparability: within-fleet only; relaxed-pin local executor, NOT comparable to the public BigCodeBench leaderboard
